title: Intent-preserving flange bore revision
purpose: Measure whether a feature revision retains the flange envelope, thickness, and unaffected bolt pattern.
complexityRationale: A second turn changes one cut feature while a concentric envelope and six-hole polar pattern must remain current and verified.

turns.text: Create a 12 mm thick, 90 mm diameter flange with a 40 mm center bore and six 8 mm bolt holes on a 70 mm bolt circle.
Increase only the center bore to 46 mm. Retain the flange envelope, thickness, and all six bolt holes.

requirements.description: The current artifact retains the 90 by 90 by 12 mm flange envelope.
The center bore is 46 mm while all six 8 mm bolt holes remain on the 70 mm bolt circle.

forbiddenOutcomes.reason: The bolt pattern and outer dimensions remain active requirements.
The original 40 mm bore evidence is stale after the revision.

sourceSafety.notes: Synthetic multi-turn flange revision with explicit retained requirements.
